paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD study of the finite-temperature topological susceptibility chi_t (2+1 flavor HISQ, continuum extrapolated, compared to DIGA). The only axion result is a cosmological upper bound on the axion decay constant: assuming the QCD axion via post-inflation misalignment (theta^2 = pi^2/3) saturates the Planck DM abundance Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199, they estimate f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV (~10% error), i.e. a lower bound on the axion mass. This is a single cosmological constraint derived from lattice chi_t plus the DM relic density, not an experimental or observational exclusion of any coupling, and not a sensitivity projection. Fig. 6 shows allowed T_osc vs f_a bands, not an exclusion curve in a canonical coupling plane. Hence is_new_limit=false. No coupling curve to report.
